body:
New project `research/gate-twin` (stylised, pure Python, 14 tests): exact gated-update MSE for a Gaussian-scale-mixture sensor, checked by quadrature and Monte Carlo. A twin with a clean Gaussian sensor says the gate costs 8.5% MSE; the real sensor gains 3.0x. Also covers the worst outlier scale and the lockout after a jump. README bullet and site entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
